segments.text:
V. 7.
There come a (bright, luminous) cloud, overſhadowing them—This ſeems to have been ſuch a Cloud of Glory, as accompanied Iſrael in the Wilderneſs, which, as the Jewiſh Writers obſerve, departed at the Death of Moſes. But it now appeared again, in Honour of our LORD, as the Great Prophet of the Church, who was prefigured by Moſes. Hear ye him—Even preferably to Moſes and Elijah.
